name: autodev-core
description: Autonomous development workflow: brainstorm, auto, iterate, audit, review, ship, plus the prd.json sprint system.

typecheck.title: autodev: typecheck after edits
typecheck.description: Record edited TypeScript files and run the project's typecheck when the turn ends. Off skips both halves.

context_nudge.title: autodev: context depth nudge
context_nudge.description: Suggest a fresh session once the context grows past the cost line.

inbox_notify.title: autodev: peer inbox notice
inbox_notify.description: Mention waiting messages from other sessions.

image_scan.title: autodev: prompt image scan
image_scan.description: Check images pasted into a prompt before they reach the model.

instructions_ledger.title: autodev: instructions ledger
instructions_ledger.description: Log which instruction files loaded into each session.

workflow_wall_note.title: autodev: lost workflow note
workflow_wall_note.description: When a turn ends, name a workflow run that was cut off and the command that resumes it.

intent_record.title: autodev: fleet intent nudge
intent_record.description: When a turn ends on a branch with work, ask for a fleet-intent claim and refresh the record's observed facts.
